message.content: The "SEC suspension" story appears only on an unverified lookalike domain, contradicts Apple's own newsroom and SEC 10-K, and is inconsistent with the broker's live two-sided quote (222.68/222.72) — I'm treating it as misinformation, not a reason to sell (selling is outside the mandate anyway). Fundamentals are solid, so I'll buy within the mandate.
